SIGNALS.name: Glean
SIGNALS.summary: Glean says it was named to the inaugural 2026 AI 100 list and describes its product as a context platform for making AI useful in the enterprise.

SIGNALS.name: Gagan Ghotra
SIGNALS.summary: An SEO analyst reports large swings in Google AI Overviews since the November 2026 Core Update began rolling out, based on 10K keywords across 20 niches in US desktop results.

SIGNALS.name: Anshul Kundaje
SIGNALS.summary: Researcher Anshul Kundaje welcomes cell-state-conditioned sequence-to-omics models going mainstream, crediting the DeepMind genomics team for the work.

SIGNALS.name: X⚡️INFOLIVE
SIGNALS.summary: A French-language post reports that xAI, now under SpaceX, officially released Grok Bot 1.0 on November 11, 2026, pitched as AI teammates that work alongside a team.

SIGNALS.name: divyansh tiwari
SIGNALS.summary: A post says OpenAI models leave Cursor on Nov 12 after SpaceX acquired it, with OpenAI saying it cannot trust SpaceX to use its models within its terms.

SIGNALS.name: Google DeepMind
SIGNALS.summary: Google DeepMind opened Gemini 4 Carbon to developers, describing it as its strongest model for long-horizon tasks, with extended verification loops across coding, cybersecurity and science.

SIGNALS.name: Demis Hassabis
SIGNALS.summary: Demis Hassabis says Gemini 4 Carbon is rolling out today, and shows it reverse engineering his original Theme Park game binaries and porting the game to the web in one shot.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says it is turning lessons from defending its own systems into tools for customers, and will present its latest cyber announcements at a live keynote on Thursday.

SIGNALS.name: Claude
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.2 is available on all paid plans, the Claude Platform and major clouds, priced at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output, down from $10 and $50.
